help.tourSub: Isiqondiso esifushane sokubheka igama lakho lokuqala.

listen.s2: Zwa igama libizwa ngendlela efanele, ngolimi lwalo.

niqqud.desc: Engeza izimpawu zonkamisa egameni lesiHebheru, noma i-tashkeel ngesi-Arabhu.
niqqud.s2: Igama lithola izimpawu zonkamisa ukuze ulifunde kahle.
account.title: Thuthukisa uphinde uphathe ipulani
account.desc: Thuthukisa ipulani uphinde uphathe ukubhaliswa kwakho.
ui.sentencePh: (Ongakukhetha) Thayipha umusho lapho igama livela khona ukuze uthole incazelo eyodwa enembile
ui.gadHint: Thepha uma usuqondile, bese igama limakwa njengeliqondakele ebhukwini lakho lamanothi
ui.gadDoneSub: Igama limakwe njengeliqondakele ebhukwini lakho lamanothi.
ui.savedNote: Leli gama nezincazelo zalo kugcinwe ebhukwini lakho lamanothi, futhi kuyatholakala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
ui.compose: Bhala owakho umusho uqinisekise ukuthi uqondile
ui.installAndroid: Faka ngokuthepha kanye, i-Gadit ivuleka njengohlelo lokusebenza lwangempela kusuka Kusikrini Sasekhaya.
ui.dupBody: Ufuna ukuxhuma kabusha iphrofayela ekhona? Wonke amagama nenqubekela phambili kuyagcinwa.
ui.reconnectNote: ✓ Ukuxhuma kabusha kubuyisa wonke amagama nenqubekela phambili.
ui.joinSub: Thayipha ikhodi enamadijithi angu-6 eyenziwe umzali wakho
ui.kidsLine: Izingane ezingu-{n} emndenini · amagama afundiwe angu-{w}
ui.leaderSub: Amagama ahlukene umuntu ngamunye asewake wawasesha kuze kube manje
ui.recentSub: Wonke amagama izingane zakho eziwaseshile, amasha kuqala.
ui.alertsSub: Thola izaziso ngakho konke izingane zakho ezikwenzayo ku-Gadit: amagama eziwaseshayo, izivivinyo zokuloba, izifundo, imidlalo nokufunda.
ui.alertsSwitch: Ngitshele ukuthi izingane zami zenzani ku-Gadit
ui.alertNowSub: Isaziso ngokushesha nje lapho zisesha igama noma ziqeda ukuzilolonga.
ui.hwPickPicSub: Lalela igama bese ukhetha isithombe salo kokuthathu
ui.ranksSub: Usuqoqe amagama angu-{n}. Igama ngalinye elisha likukhuphula phezulu
ui.toNext: Amagama angu-{n} ngaphezulu ukuze ukhuphuke izinga
ui.readerSub: Namathisela umbhalo, thatha isithombe sekhasi, layisha isithombe noma thatha isikrini.
ui.tapHint: Thepha noma yiliphi igama ukuze ubone incazelo yalo. Amagama osuwavulile aphenduka aluhlaza.
ui.saySub: Thayipha umusho, khetha ulimi olufundayo, bese uzwa kahle ukuthi usho kanjani.
ui.pasteListSub: Igama elilodwa emgqeni, ngolimi lwakho noma ngesiNgisi.
ui.pointsRule: Igama elisha = isinyathelo esiya phezulu · Ukuzilolonga okuqediwe = ama-skin amasha
ui.duelCardSub: Dlalani nibhekene: umzali nengane, izingane zakwabo noma abangani.
ui.duelSub: Imibuzo efanayo kubadlali bobabili. Oqondile nophuthumayo uyawina.
ui.dSameSub: Dlulisani idivayisi phakathi kwabadlali ngombuzo ngamunye.
ui.dInviteSub: Thumela ikhodi noma isixhumanisi emndenini noma kumngani.
ui.dOnlineSub: Umdlali ongahleliwe oneminyaka efana neyakho. Kukhona isidlaliso ne-avatar kuphela, awekho amagama futhi akukho ngxoxo.
ui.duelKidsSub: Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, izingane zakho zingadlala i-Word Duel nezinye izingane ezineminyaka efana neyayazo eziku-inthanethi ngesikhathi esifanayo. Zibona isidlaliso ne-avatar kuphela.
ui.familyLine: Kuze kufike ezinganeni ezi-5, kanye nabazali
ui.cxBody: Uqhubeka nokuthola ukufinyelela okuphelele kuze kuphele isikhathi sakho samanje. Ungaqhubeka futhi noma nini ngaphambi kwalokho.
ui.pauseBody: Ungamisa ukubhalisa inyanga eyodwa ngaphandle kokukhokha. Konke kuhlala kunjengoba kunjalo, bese ukubhalisa kuqhubeka ngokwakho ngemva kwenyanga.
ui.renewBody: Isivivinyo sakho siqhubeka kuze kube sekugcineni, futhi ngeke ukhokhiswe.
demo.mySentence: Ikati lami elifuna ukwazi lavula wonke amabhokisi endlini.
demo.feedbackMsg: Kuhle, usebenzise elithi 'curious' ngendlela efanele impela.
demo.hwList: ihhabhula, isikole, umngani, ophuzi, uthisha, ingadi
search.desc: Thayipha noma usho igama uthole zonke izincazelo zalo, izibonelo, isithombe nomsuka walo.
search.s1: Thayipha igama ebhokisini lokusesha, noma uthephe imayikhi ulisho.
search.s3: Thepha u-'Image' ngaphansi kwencazelo ukuze ubone isithombe saso.
search.s4: Ekugcineni: lapho igama livela khona, bese kuba inkinobho ethi 'Gad it!'.
save.title: Ibhuku lakho lamanothi lizigcwalisa ngokwalo
save.desc: Wonke amagama owaseshayo agcinwa ngokuzenzakalela ebhukwini lakho lamanothi.
save.s1: Wonke amagama owaseshayo agcinwa ngokwawo, akukho okufanele ukuthephele.
save.s2: Ukuze ubone amagama akho, vula u-'Notebook' kumenyu engenhla.
save.s3: Wonke amagama akho akhona lapho, futhi ezinhlelweni ezikhokhelwayo asebenza nangaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
save.s4: Ku-Basic, ibhuku lamahhala ligcina amagama angafika kwangu-30.
context.title: Incazelo efanele yomusho wakho
context.desc: Engeza umusho lapho igama livela khona uthole incazelo eyodwa efanele.
context.s1: Thayipha igama, bese enkambini engaphansi kwalo uthayipha umusho lapho livela khona.
context.s2: I-Gadit ikunikeza incazelo eyodwa efanele lowo musho.
context.s3: Le nkambu efanayo ikhona ngaphansi kwebha yokusesha kuwo wonke amakhasi egama.
wordpage.title: Okuningi ngegama ngalinye
wordpage.desc: Bhala owakho umusho, thola izibonelo ezengeziwe futhi umake igama njengeliqondakele.
wordpage.s1: Ngaphansi kwencazelo, thepha u-'Write a sentence of your own and check you understood'.
wordpage.s2: Bhala noma usho umusho wakho, thepha u-'Check sentence' bese uthola impendulo khona lapho.
wordpage.s3: Ezinhlelweni ezikhokhelwayo, u-'+ More example sentences' wengeza izibonelo ezintathu ezintsha.
wordpage.s4: Ekugcineni, thepha u-'Gad it!' bese igama limakwa njengeliqondakele ebhukwini lakho lamanothi.
extras.title: Imibuzo ngegama
extras.desc: Ezinhlelweni ezikhokhelwayo: amaphikisano, amagama afanayo, umndeni wegama, amaphutha avamile nokuthi ungalikhumbula kanjani.
extras.s1: Ngemva kuka-'Gad it!', u-'Have a question about this word?' unikeza imibuzo emihlanu.
extras.s2: Thepha umbuzo bese impendulo ivuleka ngezansi kwawo.
kids.title: Imodi Yezingane
kids.desc: Iswishi eyodwa kubha engenhla ichaza igama ngalinye ngendlela ongachazela ngayo ingane.
kids.s1: Ku-Family, vula iswishi ethi 'Kids' eceleni kwelogo.
kids.s3: Uma kuvuliwe, imenyu ikhombisa u-'Homework' esikhundleni sika-'Practice'.
kids.s4: Kudivayisi eyabiwe, vula u-'Shared kids screen' ku-My family, bese ingane ngayinye ithepha isithombe sayo.
install.desc: Engeza i-Gadit Kusikrini Sasekhaya ku-iPhone, noma uyifake ku-Android.
install.s1: Ku-iPhone, vula i-gadit.app ku-Safari bese uthepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana.
install.s2: Skrola, ukhethe u-'Add to Home Screen' bese uthepha u-'Add'.
install.s3: Ku-Android, faka uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Gadit ku-Google Play, noma uthephe u-'Install' ku-Chrome.
install.s4: I-Gadit manje ivuleka kusuka kusithonjana sayo, njengalo lonke uhlelo lokusebenza.
addchild.title: Engeza ilungu lomndeni
addchild.desc: Khetha indima, igama nombala, kube nezingane ezifika kwezi-5 ku-Family.
addchild.s1: Ku-My family, kuthebhu ethi Family, thepha u-'Add a family member'.
addchild.s2: Khetha indima: Dad, Mom, Son noma Daughter.
addchild.s3: Thayipha igama, khetha umbala, engeza iminyaka uma uthanda, bese uthepha u-'Add to family'.
addchild.s4: Uma igama selivele lisemndenini, ungaxhuma kabusha leyo phrofayela ugcine amagama ayo.
pair.desc: Xhuma idivayisi yengane ngekhodi ye-QR noma ikhodi enamadijithi angu-6.
pair.s1: Kuthebhu ethi Family, thepha u-'Pair device' ekhadini lengane.
pair.s2: Skena ikhodi ye-QR ngedivayisi yengane, noma uvule i-gadit.app/join lapho bese uthayipha ikhodi.
pair.s3: Ku-iPhone, vula i-Gadit kusuka kusithonjana sayo Kusikrini Sasekhaya bese uthepha u-'Enter code'.
pair.s4: Thayipha amadijithi ayi-6, bese ingane exhunywe kabusha ibuyiselwa wonke amagama ayo.
dash.s1: Vula u-'My family' kumenyu ye-avatar, bese ithebhu ethi Home ifingqa umndeni.
dash.s2: Ingane ngayinye inekhadi elinamazwi, uchungechunge, izinga namagama akamuva.
dash.s3: Ibhodi labahamba phambili lomndeni likhombisa ukuthi ngamunye wenu useshe amagama amangaki.
dash.s4: U-'Recent lookups' ubala wonke amagama izingane eziwaseshile, amasha kuqala.
alerts.title: Izaziso ngezingane zakho
alerts.desc: Yizwa ngamagama, ukuloba, izifundo, imidlalo, ukufunda nama-duel.
alerts.s1: Ku-My family, ku-Settings, vula u-'Tell me what my kids do in Gadit'.
alerts.s2: Khetha u-'Everything, right away' noma u-'Daily summary'.
alerts.s3: Khetha ofuna ukuzwa ngakho, bese uvula izaziso kanye kudivayisi ngayinye.
alerts.s4: Izaziso zifika nge-imeyili, futhi njengemiyalezo ebonakala ocingweni lapho kungenzeka.
homework.title: Umsebenzi wasekhaya
homework.desc: Ezinganeni eziku-Family: engeza umsebenzi wasekhaya ngesithombe noma ngokunamathisela, bese niyawuzilolonga.
homework.s1: Ku-'Homework', thepha u-Photograph, Upload noma Paste ukuze ungeze umsebenzi wanamuhla ebusuku.
homework.s2: Hlola amagama, khetha ukuthi kuyini nokuthi isivivinyo sinini, bese uthepha u-Save.
homework.s3: Umsebenzi wasekhaya ulinda ngaphansi kuka-'To do', eceleni kokufunda amagama, ukufunda nokulungiselela isivivinyo.
homework.s4: U-'Learning words' unokuloba, ukulalela nokukhetha, umdlalo wezithombe nezifundo zolimi.
ranks.title: Amazinga, uchungechunge nebhodi labahamba phambili lomndeni
ranks.desc: Igama ngalinye elisha likusondeza ezingeni elilandelayo, kanti ukuzilolonga okuqediwe kuvula ama-skin amasha.
ranks.s1: Thepha ibheji lezinga kubha engenhla ukuze ubone amazinga akho.
ranks.s2: Igama ngalinye elisha encwadini yakho likukhuphula emazingeni.
ranks.s3: Izingane zibona uchungechunge lwezinsuku, umgomo wesonto nezinga lazo, kanti amazinga aphezulu avula ukubukeka okusha.
ranks.s4: Ibhodi labahamba phambili lomndeni ku-My family likhombisa ukuthi ubani oseshe amagama amaningi kakhulu.
reader.desc: Thatha isithombe, namathisela noma layisha umbhalo, thepha noma yiliphi igama, bese uhlola ukuthi uluqondile yini.
reader.s1: Ku-'Every Word', namathisela umbhalo, thatha isithombe sekhasi, layisha isithombe noma i-PDF, noma wabelane ngesikrini sakho.
reader.s2: U-'Key words in this text' ukhombisa amagama afanele ukufundwa kuqala.
reader.s3: Thepha noma yiliphi igama ukuze ubone incazelo yalo, futhi wonke amagama owavulayo aphenduka aluhlaza.
reader.s4: Ekugcineni, ukuhlola ukufunda kubuza ukuthi amagama asho ukuthini embhalweni.
say.title: Kusho ngolunye ulimi
say.desc: Thayipha umusho, khetha ulimi, ulizwe bese uzijwayeza ukuwusho.
say.s1: Ku-'Say it', thayipha noma uqophe umusho bese ukhetha ulimi ofuna ukuwuzwa ngalo.
say.s2: Thepha u-'Say it' bese uzwa kahle ukuthi kuzwakala kanjani.
say.s3: Bese uthepha u-'Practice saying it' futhi uwusho uzwakale.
say.s4: Uthola izinkanyezi ezingafika kwezihlanu, kanye nethiphu uma kungakabi kahle okwamanje.
practice.title: Zilolonge
practice.desc: Kubantu abadala abaku-Individual naku-Family: ukufunda, ukulungiselela isivivinyo, ukuloba nolimi.
practice.s2: Khetha okukodwa kokune: ukufunda, isivivinyo, ukuloba noma ulimi.
practice.s3: Esivivinyweni, namathisela uhlu lwamagama bese uzilolonga kuze kufike usuku.
practice.s4: Ekubhaleni, uzwa igama, ulibhale bese ubona indlela efanele yokulibhala.
games.title: Imidlalo yamagama
games.desc: Imidlalo yamagama asebhukwini lakho lamanothi, nokunye okuningi.
games.s2: U-'From your notebook' udlala ngamagama owaseshile.
games.s3: Ngezansi kuneminye imidlalo ngemisuka yamagama, amagama anembile nesakhiwo samagama.
games.s4: Umdlalo ngamunye oqediwe ukusondeza ku-skin entsha.
duel.title: Word Duel
duel.desc: Imibuzo efanayo uma ubhekene nomndeni, umngani noma i-Word Bot.
duel.s2: Dlala kule divayisi, mema ngekhodi noma ngesixhumanisi, joyina ngekhodi, noma udlale ne-Word Bot.
duel.s3: Ukuze udlale nomuntu online manje, umzali uvula u-'Word Duel with other kids' ku-Settings.
duel.s4: Oqondile nophuthumayo uyawina, kanti ithebula lokuwina ligcina amaphuzu.
account.s1: Vula u-'Account' kumenyu ye-avatar ukuze ubone uhlelo lwakho.
account.s2: Ku-Basic, thepha u-'Upgrade to Family' noma u-'Upgrade to Individual'.
account.s4: Ohlelweni olukhokhelwayo, u-'Manage billing' no-'Change plan' baphatha okunye.
cancel.title: Khansela, misa noma cisha ukuvuselela
cancel.desc: Kwenzekani uma ukhansela, nezinketho ezithambile endleleni.
cancel.s1: Ku-Account, thepha u-'Cancel subscription' bese ukhetha isizathu uma uthanda.
cancel.s2: Ohlelweni lwenyanga, ungamisa inyanga eyodwa esikhundleni salokho, ngaphandle kokukhokha.
cancel.s3: Esivivinyweni samahhala, isizathu esithi 'I didn't want an automatic charge' sikuvumela ukuthi ucishe ukuvuselela kuphela.
cancel.s4: Uma ushintsha umqondo, thepha u-'I cancelled by mistake, keep the subscription'.
